name: ai-development-os
description: Local-first mission control for the Wrexist portfolio — the AI Development OS wedge (AI Control Center).

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @ado/server" "npm run dev -w @ado/web"
scripts.demo: concurrently -n server,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run start -w @ado/server -- --demo" "npm run dev -w @ado/web"
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
